retold the whole story in English out loud, from memory — the real test
level_notes: Ten stories at the 2k band — the same vocabulary layer Olga's tutor works in: abstract, functional prose words (el asunto, exigir, la cifra, sin embargo) that high-school Spanish skipped. Grammar is assumed; nothing here is drilled. Each page: the story with targets in amber, support words glossed, English behind a toggle, an eight-blank cloze with at most one support word per sentence, and a contrast set for the form-confusable pairs. The test is retelling in English, not recognising in Spanish.

skills.name: Lesson 1 · La entrevista
skills.what: A job interview that goes sideways. propósito, lograr, asunto, plazo, plantear, exigir, ventaja, surgir, apoyar.
skills.goal: Retell it in English with all nine targets in place.
skills.homework: Noun↔verb pairs aloud: apoyar/el apoyo, exigir/la exigencia, lograr/el logro.

skills.name: Lesson 2 · El aviso
skills.what: A residents' meeting about cracks in the garage. aviso, advertir, señalar, amenaza, riesgo, aumentar, medida, falta, escaso, impedir.
skills.goal: Retell in English; get advertir right — it is not advertise.
skills.homework: Find advertir, avisar and faltar in anything you read this week.

skills.name: Lesson 3 · Las cifras
skills.what: A bakery meets a spreadsheet. cifra, ingreso, gasto, retraso, muestra, suponer, reducir, alcance, mejora.
skills.goal: Retell in English including both meanings of suponer.
skills.homework: Read one business article on BBC Mundo; note every target you meet.

skills.name: Lesson 4 · El vínculo
skills.what: Two brothers, eleven years of silence. recordar, motivo, alejarse, vínculo, costumbre, ajeno, reconocer, rasgo, sostener.
skills.goal: Retell in English; explain ajeno without the word 'foreign'.
skills.homework: Contrast drill: recordar vs acordarse; el recuerdo vs la memoria.

skills.name: Lesson 5 · La huelga
skills.what: Nine days at the factory gate. huelga, queja, sueldo, negarse, esfuerzo, fracasar, despido, acuerdo, derecho.
skills.goal: Retell in English; every noun↔verb slot correct in the cloze.
skills.homework: The pairs that trip Olga's tutor too: fracaso/fracasó, queja/quejó, despido/despidió.

skills.name: Lesson 6 · La prueba
skills.what: A fallen wall, two neighbours, one builder. hecho, culpar, sin embargo, prueba, juez, testigo, ley, daño, denuncia.
skills.goal: Retell in English; use 'however' where sin embargo was.
skills.homework: Three sentences with probar: prove, try, taste.

skills.name: Lesson 7 · El proyecto
skills.what: A neighbourhood library from nothing. carecer de, presupuesto, disponer de, desarrollar, inversión, fuente, recurso, apoyo, logro.
skills.goal: Retell in English; keep disponer de and carecer de straight.

skills.name: Lesson 8 · Según la encuesta
skills.what: Expository register: a reading survey. según, encuesta, dato, tendencia, destacar, nivel, tasa, disminuir, afirmar, promedio.
skills.goal: Retell in English with the numbers intact.
skills.homework: False friends aloud: dato/fecha, tasa/taza. Then read one real survey article.

skills.name: Lesson 9 · La sequía
skills.what: An almond village without a harvest. cosecha, sequía, suelo, pérdida, entorno, clima, escasez, afectar, adaptarse, amenazar.
skills.goal: Retell in English; suelo never becomes salary or sun.

skills.name: Lesson 10 · A pesar de todo
skills.what: Review through the connectors that carry adult prose. a pesar de, aunque, mientras, sin embargo, en cambio, ni siquiera, apenas, es decir, incluso, por lo tanto.
skills.goal: Retell in English with every connector surviving.
skills.homework: Write your own year in ten sentences using at least six of these.

skills.name: Ten-minute recognition cards
skills.what: Each lesson's amber words on cards: Spanish on the front, and you must produce the English before flipping. Yes/no 'I know it' doesn't count.
skills.goal: Every earlier lesson's targets still produce their English.
skills.homework: 10 min a day, reviews before new words.

skills.name: Read one real article a week and mine it
skills.what: BBC Mundo or El País. Read once without a dictionary, then list the unknown words that appear twice — those go on the cards; the rest don't.
skills.goal: An article a week; 5–8 mined words.
skills.homework: Mined words earn their place by having appeared — don't add words you merely think you should know.

skills.name: Contrast drill: noun ↔ verb slot
skills.what: Pair every abstract noun with its verb (la queja / quejarse, el fracaso / fracasar) and say a sentence that only works with one of them.
skills.goal: Slot errors disappear from the cloze.
skills.homework: Five pairs from the current lesson, aloud, twice a week.

skills.name: Listen at the same band
skills.what: Hoy Hablamos or Español con Juan — intermediate podcasts in plain, abstract-heavy Spanish. One episode a week; the ear needs the same words the eyes are getting.
skills.goal: An episode a week for the ten weeks.
skills.homework: On the commute; no transcript the first time.
